data.name: Phantom Echoes Chapter I
data.detailed_description:
Phantom Echoes Chapter I is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival.

You play as Ronny, who finds themselves trapped in hotel. As you explore the environment, you will uncover fragments of a disturbing story while trying to understand what is real and what is not.

Gameplay revolves around:

  • Descending to Escape from entities

  • Solving environmental puzzles to progress

  • Managing limited resources such as [lantern, scanner, etc.]

  • Avoiding or surviving encounters with unknown entities

The game emphasizes atmosphere and tension over survival. Players must pay attention to sound, environment changes, and subtle visual cues to survive.

Features:

  • Immersive first-person exploration

  • Psychological horror with dynamic events

  • Puzzle-based progression

  • Minimal hand-holding and environmental storytelling

  • Estimated playtime: [6-8 hours]

  • Chapter-based story (Part of a larger narrative)

Can you uncover the truth behind the echoes, or will you become part of them?

data.short_description: After a plane journey to Delhi goes wrong, you arrive at a strange hotel surrounded by a dense forest. Something feels off. The environment seems distorted, sounds echo unnaturally, and reality itself feels unstable. Explore the mysterious hotel and escape from entities to uncover what is happening.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8th Gen / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 3050 / AMD RX 6600 (4–8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
